predecessors.name: Obotrites
predecessors.text: the Obotrites, Wismar Bay to Lake Schwerin

successors.name: Mecklenburg
successors.text: Pribislav restored as prince of Mecklenburg

ledger.x: 947: continuation of the Obotrite realm after the map's Obotrites row; the page gives no founding date.
983: Mstivoj's Obotrites destroyed Hamburg in the Great Slav Rising; the page gives no change of extent, kept as one extent.
1167: 'Obotrite regnal style was abolished'; Pribislav, last Obotrite prince (1160-1167), restored by Henry the Lion as prince of Mecklenburg.

certainty.note: The page gives only tribal districts, no borders; the outline is a stand-in.
